tools.name: vendor-compliance_onboarding-precheck
tools.description: Compare a supplied vendor record, document list, and attestations with the buyer requirements. Missing, expired, failed, and unverified items are reported separately. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/vendor-compliance/onboarding-precheck. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vendor-compliance_contractor-prequalification
tools.description: Compare buyer qualification criteria with supplied vendor facts, documents, and evidence. The result does not award eligibility or query a registry. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/vendor-compliance/contractor-prequalification. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vendor-compliance_subcontractor-payment-readiness
tools.description: List missing payment documents and caller-supplied open items. This check does not release a payment or rerun sanctions, wage, or certificate screens. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/vendor-compliance/subcontractor-payment-readiness. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vendor-compliance_document-completeness
tools.description: Compare a supplied document inventory with a buyer requirements list. Files are not fetched, and a present document is not treated as verified content. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/vendor-compliance/document-completeness. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vendor-compliance_report
tools.description: Consolidate supplied vendor information, documents, attestations, evidence, and open items into one requirements report. External registries are not contacted. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/vendor-compliance/report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vendor-compliance_contractor-closeout-check
tools.description: Compare buyer closeout requirements with supplied documents and attestations. A passing result does not certify that the project is complete. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/vendor-compliance/contractor-closeout-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "vendor-compliance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vendor-compliance_onboarding-precheck, vendor-compliance_subcontractor-payment-readiness, vendor-compliance_document-completeness, vendor-compliance_report, vendor-compliance_contractor-closeout-check · Private data: vendor-compliance_onboarding-precheck, vendor-compliance_contractor-prequalification, vendor-compliance_subcontractor-payment-readiness, vendor-compliance_document-completeness, vendor-compliance_report, vendor-compliance_contractor-closeout-check · Public sink: vendor-compliance_onboarding-precheck, vendor-compliance_contractor-prequalification, vendor-compliance_subcontractor-payment-readiness, vendor-compliance_document-completeness, vendor-compliance_report, vendor-compliance_contractor-closeout-check · Destructive: vendor-compliance_onboarding-precheck, vendor-compliance_contractor-prequalification, vendor-compliance_subcontractor-payment-readiness, vendor-compliance_document-completeness, vendor-compliance_report, vendor-compliance_contractor-closeout-check.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
